lines.en: label ayanepool55:
scene ayanepooltalk1
I decide to spend the end of the school day at the pool with Ayane instead of being responsible and utilizing these hours to pretend to be a guidance counselor instead.
lines.zh: 我决定把放学后的时间花在泳池边陪 Ayane，而不是负责任地利用这几个小时去假扮一个升学指导顾问。

lines.en: It is not the most mature decision I have made, particularly because the amount of latex in this room directly impacted my decision to come here, but I suppose that doesn’t really matter right now.
lines.zh: 这不是我做过最成熟的决定——尤其是我之所以来这儿，很大程度上是被这间屋子里乳胶的含量所影响，不过我想现在这一点也不重要了。

lines.en: If Ayane really is trying to face the world with a renewed lease on life and that same level of optimism she had when I {i}first{/i} started having sex with her, I owe it to her to reciprocate that.
lines.zh: 如果 Ayane 真的想以重新焕发的生命力、以及我{i}刚开始{/i}和她上床时她身上那种乐观去面对这个世界，那我就有义务回应她。

lines.en: Not the optimism, of course. Or the happiness either as I’m pretty sure I’m almost entirely incapable of showing {i}either{/i} of those traits.
lines.zh: 当然不是回应乐观。快乐也不是——我敢说，我几乎完全不具备表现出这{i}两种{/i}特质的能力。

lines.en: But what I {i}will{/i} reciprocate is a level of focus that miraculously evades the many asses in this room and hones in on her instead.
lines.zh: 但我{i}会{/i}回应的，是一种专注——奇迹般地绕开这间屋子里那许多屁股，单单落在她身上的专注。

lines.en: We have each other. And we will continue to have each other in every way until one of our brains turn into goo or our memories are wiped clean like the world’s most complicated dry-erase board.
lines.zh: 我们拥有彼此。而我们也会继续以各种方式拥有彼此，直到我们其中一个的脑子变成一摊糊，或者我们的记忆像世界上最复杂的白板一样被擦得干干净净。

lines.en: Everything begins to spin again.
lines.zh: 一切又开始旋转了。

lines.en: Just this time, it’s in a way that doesn’t make us dizzy.
lines.zh: 只是这一次，转的方式不会让我们头晕。

lines.en: : ...and that’s how I wound up freeing all of the lobsters in Kumon-mi from the tyranny of those evil grocery stores.
lines.zh: : ……我就是这样把 Kumon-mi 所有的龙虾，从那些邪恶杂货店的暴政中解放出来的。

lines.en: : Admirable story, Ayane. I particularly enjoyed the part with the bowling tournament.
lines.zh: : 令人敬佩的故事，Ayane。我尤其喜欢保龄球比赛那一段。

lines.en: : I don’t know how I could have accomplished my goal without that. But that’s enough about my Tuesday- we can talk about more interesting stuff now.
lines.zh: : 没有那个我真不知道该怎么达成目标。不过我的星期二就聊到这儿吧——现在我们可以聊点更有趣的事了。

lines.en: : More interesting than lobster liberation? That’s a pretty big ask. I’m not sure if I’ll be able to contribute in a meaningful way.
lines.zh: : 比解放龙虾更有趣？这要求可够高的。我不确定自己能不能做出什么有意义的贡献。

lines.en: : Well...Halloween’s right around the corner. We could always talk about that? That should be pretty interesting-ish, right?
lines.zh: : 嗯……万圣节就在眼前了。我们可以聊聊那个？那应该……挺有趣的吧，对吧？

lines.en: : I still haven’t decided what I’m going to dress up as this year. Maybe you can help me brainstorm or something?
lines.zh: : 我还没决定今年要扮什么。也许你可以帮我出出主意什么的？

lines.en: : Giving me full control over what you wear is a dangerous thing to do, Ayane.
lines.zh: : 把穿什么的权利全交给我，可是件危险的事，Ayane。

lines.en: : If Chika can dress up as a sex-dog, I’m pretty sure that anything you want to put me in will work out just fine.
lines.zh: : 如果 Chika 都能扮成一只发情狗，那我敢肯定，你想让我穿什么都不会有问题。

lines.en: : Then I will ask that you also dress up as a sex-dog this year. Even if I’m pretty confident there’s a better name for whatever costume that was.
lines.zh: : 那我就要求你今年也扮成一只发情狗。虽然我很确信那套衣服有个更好听的名字。

lines.en: scene ayanepooltalk2
: I will see what I can do. But keep in mind that I’m not exactly known for {i}risque{/i} costumes like that.
lines.zh: : 我会尽力而为。不过别忘了，我可不以那种{i}大胆{/i}的服装出名。

lines.en: : I can see why. They don’t really fit your personality.
lines.zh: : 我看得出来。它们跟你的性格不太搭。

lines.en: scene ayanepooltalk3
: You think so?
lines.zh: : 你这么觉得？

lines.en: if ayanelust10 == True and ayanebonus2 == True:
: Yeah. For a hypersexual teen who has now had threesomes with two of her classmates, you’re extremely wholesome. It’s kind of weird actually.
lines.zh: : 嗯。作为一个性欲旺盛的少女，而且已经和两位同学玩过三人行了，你却纯洁得要命。说真的还挺怪的。

lines.en: : The first threesome didn’t count. And yeah, it’s probably a little harder to call me wholesome now that you’ve watched me suck your jizz out of the sex-dog’s mouth.
lines.zh: : 第一次三人行不算。而且是啊，既然你都看过我把你的精液从那只发情狗嘴里吸出来了，现在要说我纯洁大概更难了。

lines.en: : Is Chika just permanently “the sex-dog” now?
lines.zh: : Chika 现在是永久性地被叫做「发情狗」了吗？

lines.en: : Sure. I think it fits her pretty well.
lines.zh: : 是啊。我觉得这外号挺适合她的。

lines.en: elif ayanelust10 == False and ayanebonus2 == True:
: Yeah. For a hypersexual teen coming off of her first threesome, you’re extremely wholesome. It’s kind of weird actually.
lines.zh: : 嗯，对一个刚经历完第一次三人行的性欲旺盛少女来说，你纯洁得要命。说真的还挺怪的。

lines.en: : Yeah, it’s probably a little harder to call me wholesome now that you’ve watched me suck your jizz out of the sex-dog’s mouth.
lines.zh: : 是啊，既然你都看过我把你的精液从那只发情狗嘴里吸出来了，现在要说我纯洁大概更难了。

lines.en: : Is Chika just permanently “the sex-dog” now?
lines.zh: : Chika 现在是永久性地被叫做「发情狗」了吗？

lines.en: : Sure. I think it fits her pretty well.
lines.zh: : 是啊。我觉得这外号挺适合她的。

lines.en: else:
: Yeah, for a hypersexual teen who’s let me cum inside her more times than I can count, you’re surprisingly wholesome. It’s kind of weird actually.
lines.zh: : 嗯，对一个让我射在里面的次数多得数不清的性欲旺盛少女来说，你清新得出人意料。说真的还挺怪的。

lines.en: : Thanks. I think.
lines.zh: : 谢谢。我想是吧。

lines.en: : That {i}was{/i} a compliment, right?
lines.zh: : 那算{i}是{/i}夸我，对吧？

lines.en: : Sure. Why not?
lines.zh: : 当然。为什么不呢？

lines.en: : In regard to your actual Halloween costume, though- just do whatever you want. I’d be lying if I said I wasn’t a fan of the group cosplay stuff you guys have done the last couple years, so that’s always welcome.
lines.zh: : 不过说回你真正的万圣节服装——随便你想穿什么。要是说我对你们这几年搞的团体 cosplay 不感兴趣，那就是撒谎，所以那种随时欢迎。

lines.en: : I’ll be happy as long as you don’t pull a Maya and go to whatever party we’re having this year dressed up as me.
lines.zh: : 只要你别学 Maya，穿成我的样子去参加今年的派对，我就心满意足了。

lines.en: scene ayanepooltalk4
: Aww, but I think I’d look really cute in your clothes.
lines.zh: : 哎呀，可我觉得穿上你的衣服会很可爱啊。

lines.en: : Ayane, I might be a narcissist. But even {i}I{/i} don’t want to have sex with myself.
lines.zh: : Ayane，{i}我{/i}可能是个自恋狂。但就算是我，也不想和自己上床。

lines.en: : Yeah, but that’s only because you have a penis. If you didn’t, you’d be all over yourself. And I’d also probably become bisexual.
lines.zh: : 是啊，可那只是因为你有鸡巴。要是你没有，你早就把自己迷得死死的了。而且我大概也会变成双性恋。

lines.en: : I’m just going to warn you now. If I come home one of these days and find you in my closet, I am not going to be happy.
lines.zh: : 我现在就警告你。要是哪天我回家发现你在我衣柜里，我可不会高兴。

lines.en: : Really? I can’t even borrow a big shirt to sleep in or something? Wouldn’t it be nice seeing me in an oversized t-shirt the night after sleeping over while I cook you breakfast? I think that sounds nice.
lines.zh: : 真的吗？我连借件大衬衫睡觉都不行吗？留宿的第二天早上，看着我穿着超大号 T 恤给你做早餐，不是挺好的吗？我觉得那听起来很棒。

lines.en: : I’m sure it would be very nice in the ten seconds before Ami chops your head off.
lines.zh: : 在 Ami 把你的头砍下来之前的十秒钟里，我想一定会很棒。

lines.en: scene ayanepooltalk2
: Ami won’t do anything to me. I’m safe and free to do anything I please and nobody can stop me. That’s Ayane 2.0’s whole thing. Remember?
lines.zh: : Ami 不会把我怎么样的。我很安全，可以随心所欲做任何事，没人拦得住我。这就是 Ayane 2.0 的宗旨。记得吗？

lines.en: : Can you teach me whatever this mysterious anti-Ami method of yours is next? Because, even if she’s been easing up lately, I still feel like it’ll come in handy knowing how you’re keeping her at bay.
lines.zh: : 那你下次能不能把这套神秘的「防 Ami 大法」教教我？因为就算她最近收敛了不少，我还是觉得，知道你是怎么把她挡住的会很有用。

lines.en: : I’m keeping her at bay with the power of friendship of course.
lines.zh: : 我当然是用友情的力量把她挡住的啦。

lines.en: : Ayane-
lines.zh: : Ayane——

lines.en: scene ayanepooltalk5
: Didn’t I already tell you that was a secret? Just accept my safety and go back to telling me what sort of costumes you want to make love to me in.
lines.zh: : 我不是说过那是秘密吗？接受我很安全这个事实就好，然后继续告诉我，你想让我穿什么衣服来跟我做爱。

lines.en: : My confidence has taken a beating over the last year and I could really use the boost.
lines.zh: : 这一年下来我的自信被打击得不轻，我真的需要补一补。

lines.en: : I would have sex with you no matter what you’re wearing.
lines.zh: : 不管你穿什么，我都会和你做爱。

lines.en: : Dolphin costume it is.
lines.zh: : 那就海豚装了。

lines.en: : Wouldn’t be the first time I’ve had sex with someone who’s been in that thing.
lines.zh: : 我和穿着那玩意儿的人上床，也不是第一次了。

lines.en: scene ayanepooltalk6
: {i}You had sex with Sana?! When?! She wasn’t on the list! Also, how?!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你和 Sana 上过床？！什么时候？！她不在名单上啊！而且，怎么做到的？！{/i}

lines.en: : Not Sana, Niki. She was the one in the costume last year.
lines.zh: : 不是 Sana，是 Niki。去年穿那套衣服的是她。

lines.en: scene ayanepooltalk7
: Niki was the mystery-dolphin? But why would she-
lines.zh: : Niki 就是那只神秘海豚？可她为什么——

lines.en: scene ayanepooltalk8
: Wait, Niki wasn’t on the list either. At least...not in the sex column.
lines.zh: : 等等，Niki 也不在名单上。至少……不在性爱那一栏。

lines.en: : That...is a relatively new development.
lines.zh: : 那……是相对较新的进展。

lines.en: : So...you and your long-time ex-girlfriend who is not only very famous, but your childhood-friend...are together again?
lines.zh: : 所以……你和那位不仅很有名、还是你青梅竹马的前女友……又在一起了？

lines.en: : If you’re worried, you shouldn’t be. I don’t plan on leaving you any time soon.
lines.zh: : 如果你在担心，那大可不必。我短期内没打算离开你。

lines.en: : Is there...anyone {i}else{/i} you’ve added to the list since writing it? Should I grab you another pen and paper?
lines.zh: : 写那张名单之后，你{i}还{/i}往上面加了谁吗？要不要我再给你拿纸和笔？

lines.en: : There...
: There is.
lines.zh: : 有的。

lines.en: scene ayanepooltalk9
: {i}Hah...{/i}Okay. Hit me. Who is it this time?
lines.zh: : {i}哈……{/i}好吧。说吧。这次是谁？

lines.en: : It’s Nodoka.
lines.zh: : 是 Nodoka。

lines.en: scene ayanepooltalk10
: Tch. So she’s not all talk after all.
lines.zh: : 啧。看来她不只是嘴上说说而已啊。

lines.en: : She’s...different, though.
lines.zh: : 不过她……不太一样。

lines.en: scene ayanepooltalk11
: Considering who we’re talking about, that could mean a number of things.
lines.zh: : 考虑到我们说的是谁，这句话可以有好几种意思。

lines.en: : What I mean is that I don’t really feel anything for her. It’s just sort of a thing that happened.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是，我对她其实没什么感觉。只是那么发生了。

lines.en: : As in you both accidentally got naked and slipped and your penis wound up inside of her vagina?
lines.zh: : 就像你们俩意外地都脱光了，然后脚一滑，你的鸡巴就滑进了她的阴道？

lines.en: : I actually kind of wish it {i}did{/i} go down like that. That would be way easier to...accept and understand.
lines.zh: : 说实话我还{i}真{/i}希望事情是那样发生的。那样会容易……接受和理解得多。

lines.en: : I’m...confused. But, at the risk of learning more details and tarnishing my happiness, I say we just get back to the topic at hand.
lines.zh: : 我……有点懵。不过，冒着听到更多细节、毁掉我现在这份幸福的风险，我建议我们还是回到正题吧。

lines.en: : Fine. Where’d we leave off again? Something about having sex with Sana?
lines.zh: : 好。我们刚才说到哪儿了？好像是和 Sana 上床的事？

lines.en: scene ayanepooltalk12
: Almost. We were talking about Halloween before we got sidetracked by another sex-animal.
lines.zh: : 差不多了。在被另一只性爱动物带偏之前，我们正在聊万圣节。

lines.en: : Right, right. Any word on where this year’s party will be? We haven’t been to your place in a while. Maybe that will work?
lines.zh: : 对，对。今年的派对定在哪儿有消息了吗？我们好久没去你家了。也许可以去那儿？

lines.en: : There’s no word on that just yet. But I’ve actually been thinking it might be fun if we do our {i}own{/i} thing this year too. After the party, I mean.
lines.zh: : 这个还没有消息。不过我其实一直在想，今年我们也可以{i}自己{/i}再搞点活动——我是说派对之后。

lines.en: : Just you and me?
lines.zh: : 就你和我？

lines.en: scene ayanepooltalk1
: And the other members of the Love Squad. Sana too if you can promise not to have sex with her.
lines.zh: : 还有 Sensei 爱之小队的其他成员。如果你能保证不和 Sana 上床，也可以带上她。

lines.en: : Do I have to?
lines.zh: : 我非保证不可吗？

lines.en: : Only if you want her to maintain the feeling in her lower body.
lines.zh: : 如果你想让她下半身还保有知觉的话。

lines.en: : I’ll have to get back to you on that.
lines.zh: : 这个我得回头再答复你。

lines.en: : What do you think, though? Is that something you’d be interested in? We could do it at your place or...maybe the karaoke lounge? I don’t know. I just kind of feel like trying something a little different.
lines.zh: : 不过你觉得呢？你有兴趣吗？我们可以在你家办，或者……KTV？我不知道。我就是有点想试试不一样的。

lines.en: : The big group parties are fun and all, but something a bit more intimate sounds like it would be way more enjoyable for me on a personal level. And I’m sure Sana would agree.
lines.zh: : 大型的团体派对是好玩，但更私密一点的，听起来对我个人来说会开心得多。而且我敢肯定 Sana 也会同意。

lines.en: : Fine by me. We’ll just have to think of a way to get me away from everyone else since I’m {i}kind of{/i} the center of attention at all of our group outings.
lines.zh: : 我没意见。只是我们得想个办法把我从其他人身边支开——毕竟我们每次集体活动，我{i}都{/i}是众人瞩目的中心。

lines.en: : Well, all things considered, it’ll definitely be easier than it would have been last year. I’m sure we’ll think of something.
lines.zh: : 嗯，综合考虑下来，肯定比去年容易多了。我们肯定能想出办法的。

lines.en: : Just let me know. We’ll call breaking away from the other girls for a {i}second{/i} party one of my first steps toward adopting this new carefree outlook you seem to have on life.
lines.zh: : 到时候告诉我就行。就把「从其他女孩身边溜走、去开{i}第二{/i}场派对」，当作我迈向你所拥有的那种无忧无虑的人生观的第一步吧。

lines.en: scene ayanepooltalk13
: Follow me into the light, Sensei. For only {i}I{/i} can show you what it means to be free.
lines.zh: : 跟我走进光里吧，Sensei。因为只有{i}我{/i}能让你明白什么叫做自由。

lines.en: : Is that...a Yasu impression?
lines.zh: : 这是……在模仿 Yasu？

lines.en: scene ayanepooltalk14
: Pretty good, right? I’ve been practicing.
lines.zh: : 挺像的吧？我一直在练。

lines.en: : {i}Why?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}为什么？{/i}

lines.en: : I figure that if I get good enough at imitating all of the other girls that you won’t have a reason to have sex with any of them anymore.
lines.zh: : 我想，如果我能把其他所有女孩都模仿得惟妙惟肖，你就没有理由再和她们中的任何一个上床了。

lines.en: : That was a joke. I’m not being serious.
lines.zh: : 那是开玩笑的。我不是认真的。

lines.en: : I never really know with you.
lines.zh: : 跟你在一起，我永远分不清。

lines.en: scene ayanepooltalk15
: Hey, I’ve gotten pretty good at suppressing my crazy side.
lines.zh: : 嘿，我已经很擅长压抑自己疯狂的那一面了。

lines.en: : That’s what I thought until you gave me an exact duplicate of my phone, complete with all of my contacts and wallpaper.
lines.zh: : 在我收到一部和我手机一模一样的复制品之前，我也是这么想的——连联系人和壁纸都一样。

lines.en: : Pretty good doesn’t mean “perfect.” I still have my flaws. I’m just a little better at not showing them now. But again, this will continue to improve with every cycle.
lines.zh: : 「很擅长」不等于「完美」。我还是有缺点的。只是现在更擅长不把它们表现出来而已。不过话说回来，每经历一轮循环，这方面都会继续进步。

lines.en: : Ayane 2.0 is here not just to {i}stay,{/i} but to be the backbone everyone needs when confronting this big, scary world we find ourselves in.
lines.zh: : Ayane 2.0 不只是来了{i}就不走了{/i}，还要成为所有人面对这个又大又可怕的世界时所需要的支柱。

lines.en: : Well, keep it up and even {i}Maya{/i} might be smiling soon enough.
lines.zh: : 嗯，继续保持，说不定连 {i}Maya{/i} 都快要笑了。

lines.en: scene ayanepooltalk16
: Actually, I’m glad you brought her up- because I’ve been meaning to ask you something.
lines.zh: : 其实，我很高兴你提到她——因为我一直想问你一件事。

lines.en: : I know Ami’s changes are kind of obvious because of this whole “Stop suffocating me” policy you’re starting to enforce, but...don’t you think Maya’s been acting a little different lately too?
lines.zh: : 我知道 Ami 的变化挺明显的，因为你开始推行那套「别再让我窒息」的政策，可是……你不觉得 Maya 最近也有点不一样吗？

lines.en: : Different how?
lines.zh: : 怎么个不一样？

lines.en: : Well, for one, she asked me if I needed a {i}hug{/i} the other day.
lines.zh: : 首先，她前几天问我要不要{i}抱一下{/i}。

lines.en: : You’re right. That is very concerning.
lines.zh: : 你说得对。这确实很令人担忧。

lines.en: : It’s not just that either, but...it’s kind of hard to describe. She just feels kind of off. Did anything happen with you two?
lines.zh: : 也不只是这个，只是……有点难形容。就是感觉她有点不对劲。你们俩之间发生过什么吗？

lines.en: : Apart from the near-kiss? Not really. Maybe her...real personality is just starting to leak out or something?
lines.zh: : 除了那个差点接吻？没有。也许她……真实的性格开始慢慢漏出来了？

lines.en: : She’s had to keep a brave face on for what I can only imagine is an absurd amount of time. We can’t really fault her if that mask starts to crack now that she’s starting to feel a little more comfortable.
lines.zh: : 她必须一直戴着那张勇敢的面具，时间之长我简直无法想象。如果她开始觉得自在一些、那张面具开始出现裂痕，我们也不能真的怪她。

lines.en: scene ayanepooltalk17
: I guess you’re right. There’s no way of knowing how either one of us would feel in her shoes, so...it could just be normal character development or something.
lines.zh: : 我想你是对的。我们谁都不知道自己处在她的位置会是什么感受，所以……也可能只是正常的角色成长之类的。

lines.en: : She’s just been the same old {i}Maya{/i} for so long though that I can’t help but worry any time she does something even slightly different.
lines.zh: : 只是她当那个万年不变的 {i}Maya{/i} 太久了，所以哪怕她有一丁点不一样，我都忍不住会担心。

lines.en: : Either way, you know her better than I do. So I’ll just take your word for it.
lines.zh: : 不管怎样，你比我了解她。所以我就信你的。

lines.en: : I wouldn’t say I know her any better than you. Just that I have a higher chance of making out with her.
lines.zh: : 我可不敢说我比你更了解她。只能说我跟她接吻的概率更高一点。

lines.en: : Is it the same for Miku as well? Because I’ve noticed she hasn’t been acting like herself lately either.
lines.zh: : Miku 也是一样吗？因为我注意到她最近也不太像她自己。

lines.en: : I...might have an idea as to why. But, for clarity’s sake, what do {i}you{/i} mean?
lines.zh: : 我……可能知道一点原因。不过为了弄清楚，{i}你{/i}指的是什么？

lines.en: scene ayanepooltalk18
: Well, for one, she’s not running around and screaming.
lines.zh: : 首先，她不再跑来跑去大喊大叫了。

lines.en: : In fact, I can’t even tell if she’s awake right now.
lines.zh: : 事实上，我现在甚至看不出她是不是醒着。

lines.en: : I know Imani and Makoto have been cracking down on the girls with lower grades lately. And come to think of it, I'm pretty sure that’s why Makoto isn’t here today.
lines.zh: : 我知道 Imani 和 Makoto 最近在狠抓成绩差的那几个女生。而且这么一想，我敢肯定 Makoto 今天不在这儿就是因为那个。

lines.en: : Do you think this might have something to do with that?
lines.zh: : 你觉得会不会跟这个有关？

lines.en: : It...could.
lines.zh: : ……有可能。

lines.en: Or it could be something completely different that I shouldn’t bother Ayane about as it has nothing to do with her...
lines.zh: 也可能完全是另一回事，一件我不需要拿去烦 Ayane 的事，因为那跟她没有关系……

lines.en: scene ayanepooltalk19
: Hey, Miku. Are you awake over there? Aren’t you going to swim today?
lines.zh: : 嘿，Miku。你醒着吗？今天不游泳吗？

lines.en: scene ayanepooltalk20
: Maybe she really is asleep?
lines.zh: : 也许她真的睡着了？

lines.en: : Should we...just let her rest? She probably needs it if it’s from overworking herself, right? I can’t imagine all those worksheets are doing her any favors.
lines.zh: : 我们要不要……就让她休息？如果是累过头了，她大概需要休息吧？我想象不出那一堆练习卷对她有什么好处。

lines.en: : Uhh...
scene black
: Actually, I’m going to let someone who’s better at this sort of thing deal with it. I think this might be a little more than just...being overworked.
lines.zh: : 其实，我打算让更擅长这种事的人来处理。我觉得这可能不只是……累过头了那么简单。

lines.en: : More how? Do you know what’s going on?
lines.zh: : 不只是什么？你知道发生了什么吗？

lines.en: Leaving Ayane on the bench, I make my way over to the girl who is inarguably the most mature person in this room.
lines.zh: 我把 Ayane 留在长椅上，朝这间屋子里毫无疑问最成熟的那个女孩走去。

lines.en: : Karin, have you talked to Miku today?
lines.zh: : Karin，你今天和 Miku 说过话吗？

lines.en: : Hm? I did earlier. Why do you ask?
lines.zh: : 嗯？之前说过。你为什么问这个？

lines.en: : She’s just...
lines.zh: : 她只是……

lines.en: : She looks a little out of it right now, don’t you think?
lines.zh: : 她现在看起来有点神不守舍，你不觉得吗？

lines.en: : Out of it how? What’s-
lines.zh: : 神不守舍？什么——

lines.en: : Wait, is she {i}asleep?{/i} During {i}club?{/i}
lines.zh: : 等等，她{i}睡着了{/i}？{i}社团活动{/i}的时候？

lines.en: : I was beginning to wonder why it’s been so quiet all day...I suppose that explains it.
lines.zh: : 我还在想今天怎么这么安静……看来是这么回事。

lines.en: : Sorry, Nodoka. I’ll be back in a second. I’m just gonna go check up on her really quick.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，Nodoka。我马上回来。我去看看她。

lines.en: Karin leaves Nodoka’s side, prompting Ayane to get off the bench and head over toward me as the lot of us move closer to Miku.
lines.zh: Karin 离开 Nodoka 身边，Ayane 也从长椅上起身朝我走来，我们一群人一起朝 Miku 靠近。

lines.en: $ ayanepool55 = True
$ ayane_love += 1
jump mikupool55
